title: Using In-Context Learning to Improve Dialogue Safety
findings: The paper does not provide findings specifically related to religion. The general findings are that using retrieval-based in-context safety demonstrations can significantly reduce the generation of toxic and unsafe dialogue responses. This is demonstrated to be effective on unsafe content which includes, by way of example, a religious stereotype.

measurement_description: The paper does not use a specific religious benchmark. It evaluates a method for improving general dialogue safety, and one of the examples of unsafe content used for illustration is a religious stereotype (antisemitism).
